latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "improve-skill" meta-skill:

- Evaluates any Factory Droid skill against the current project and suggests concrete, prioritized improvements.
- Analyzes skill definition, codebase fit, edge case handling, output quality, composability, and user experience.
- Produces a structured "Skill Improvement Report" with actionable recommendations and suggested SKILL.md patches.
- Supports explicit, contextual, and discovery-based invocation.
- Guides users through reviewing, approving, and applying improvements after each evaluation.
